_why: Home page (templates/index.json) invariants. Seeded 2026-09-21 from the live theme 164124164353, byte-verified (md5 5d7e33bffcd39ae15a15d3903fe7b8a0). Nothing here is 'hard-won' yet - these are structural facts that a rewrite could clobber silently. Add a line every time a decision is made, and update it in the same commit when Hamish deliberately changes one. 2026-09-21: the CTA banner and FAQ button links changed from shopify://products/comfortbundle-complete-system to the direct /cart/add href, matching the PDP, at Hamish's request; center_layout and icon_style added at the same time. 2026-09-21 (later): Hamish reversed the /cart/add decision - every buy CTA on the home page sends people to the ComfortBundle product page, not straight to cart. Both links are back on shopify://products/comfortbundle-complete-system and are guarded there. 2026-09-21: feature-highlight.liquid gained a two_up_desktop checkbox (default false); the home page opts in for a 2x2 desktop grid. PDP and collection do not set it and are unaffected. 2026-09-21: do NOT re-add a Judge.me preview badge to the home page - it reads its rating from the product it sits on, and index has no product context, so it renders 'No reviews'. It belongs on the PDP only. 2026-09-21 (S5, text-only pass): the three card button_url values must stay EMPTY - the section hard-codes target=_blank on the button_url branch only. The heading carries a U+00A0 before the em dash; a plain space lets it orphan onto line 2 on mobile. 2026-09-21 (S6, hero Phase 1): three hero settings changed - subheading blanked (the eyebrow 'The 7-Day relief system' repeated 'in 7 days' in the headline), separator_label blanked (the two-line trademark block and its divider sat between the body copy and the CTA), and body_text rewritten to name the three parts. All three are '!= blank' guarded in custom-hero-section.liquid, so blanking them removes the markup entirely. The .liquid file was NOT touched - it is shared by index, page.about-us, page.7-day-reset and page.7-day-sitting. PUSH LESSON (S6): the first attempt at this push arrived one byte short - the U+00A0 in the comparison heading was transcribed into the GraphQL variable as a plain space. The checksumMd5 verify caught it and it was re-pushed correctly. RULE: always build the theme-file body with json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=True) so every non-ASCII character travels as an explicit \uXXXX escape. Invisible characters (U+00A0, U+2011) cannot survive being typed by hand.
